dogecoin.text: Mesh is integrating Apple Pay for crypto, making retail transactions smoother—while BTC hovers near $95K amid tariff debates and Dogecoin holds steady. Our crypto ecosystem is maturing, balancing tech advances with careful regulatory moves. #crypto

UK’s FCA is inviting crypto feedback on staking & DeFi while Tokyo’s Metaplanet raises $25M via no-interest bonds to boost its BTC stash past 5K. XRP ETF approval at 85% & Dogecoin gains further evidence that institutional momentum is reshaping crypto.

Crypto’s in transition: BTC nears $100K as Dogecoin & Cardano surge on dovish Fed hints & UK trade deal hope. Meanwhile, OCC embraces crypto custody & Ethereum's Pectra upgrade strengthens network utility. Institutional interest is rising—but caution remains.

Dogecoin rockets past key resistance, eyeing $0.65 as investors shift to alt assets amid uncertainty. Meanwhile, @JamesWynn swaps a $1B BTC play for a leveraged Pepe bet netting ~$25M profit. Crypto volatility is real—stay agile, stay cautious.
